scientific_scope: R6-C.1B targeted re-collection: early-window t={0,8,16} boundaries, new candidate states, and new rollout seed indices; enrichment vs natural-eval separation

qualified_source_policies.reason: R6-C.1A gate PASSED; new seed 1 adds failure support
R6-C.1A gate failed only on positive count (6<10); seeds 2-3 add source-failure support

early_window.after_t16_decision: if source chosen at t16, lock source to termination; if switch, OFT persistent to termination (no emergency trigger)
early_window.note: t=8 is newly collected; R6-C.1A used t={0,16} only

data_split.natural_development_eval: 48 new pool states (pre-registered metadata only) under the new seed plan, merged with the existing B1.2 natural cohort; enters the natural-distribution gate
data_split.train_enrichment: screening-selected hard cases (source failure / difficult success); may be over-sampled in training folds, NEVER in the eval gate
data_split.fold_binding: all states, seeds and replicas of the same task_id stay in the same outer fold

reproducibility.strict_parity_only_for: existing (state, policy, seed) triples with a frozen R6-A reference
reproducibility.new_triples: rep0/rep1 repeat the exact same rollout_seed; if success/terminal steps/boundary labels disagree, run rep2 only for affected triples; source-success flips after rep2 are excluded from hard labels; stable-label step differences remain replica-level cost trials
reproducibility.natural_replica_evaluation: natural rep0 only; rep1/rep2 may augment outer-fold training but never threshold calibration or OOF evaluation

supervision_only_features: OFT action at the restored boundary
persistent teacher steps if entered now

evaluation.threshold_selection: outer-train task-held-out natural calibration split; never outer validation labels; each outer fold keeps its own threshold
evaluation.bootstrap: task-cluster resampling of frozen fold-specific trajectory decisions; never average fold thresholds
execution_order: explicit approval for OFT label collection
evaluation.per_vla_stop_rule: clear failure terminates the current learned-selector escalation; one diagnostic iteration is allowed only for a predeclared near-pass (both VLAs >=3/5 passing seeds and every mean primary metric within 2pp of its limit)

conditional_missed_rescue.note: reported with task-cluster bootstrap intervals; no 5% hard gate until a power analysis supports it (Pi0.5 rescue positives too few)

world_model_lock.unlock_condition: both VLAs pass >=4/5 seeds of the no-WM R6-C.1 gate
